title: I would love to see some improvements
body:
Over all Reminders is good but it’s not great. 

There are a lot of small UX issues all over the place which I would love to see fixed making it great. 

For instance when I get a notification about a reminder and I want to reschedule it, when I click on reschedule I would expect to see reminder details where I can easily set different time or date. Instead I have Reminder open the task list and focus on the individual reminder forcing another click to get to details or worse yet if I click any where else by mistake I totally lost the reminder and need to start searching for it which can be a huge problem if I don’t remember the exact text

title: It’s not easy to use
body:
It has to be snappy fast app
I got new task “do this and that, remember from this and that date do this and that,…”
You need to input it fast, you need to input it without fiddling with menus, it’s tasks - not a diary..

I ended up only using the Today list. One list, it stays there, it tells you how much days past since created…that’s it.

Currently it’s just to much effort to input new task, select the category you want…it’s for people who like to fiddle with menus and submenus. I have no time.

Also u would have integrated it into a calendar, as calendar is almost same thing as tasks if you think about it. Most often I don’t know what I prefer to use.

I think you need AI text interpreter built into the phone.

First - app doesn’t support drop down list for sub tasks in “Today” tasks tab, it doesn’t make sense not to support and it should be a must!
Second - if I mark done for a reoccurring tasks after the day it is due, then I would expect the next time the reoccurring task pops up should be from the day I set done. E.g. lets say there is a reoccurring tasks which repeats every week on sunday, and I mark done on Tuesday, the next time the reoccurring task should show is now on Tuesday and not Sunday.
author: Honest Reviewer 492837

title: Gets the job done with very little delight
body:
This is such a basic app and I'd be surprised if many people at Apple actually use it since it's highly unusable. Many of its features are only partially implemented.
Nevertheless it gets the job done (=reminding me about stuff I set a reminder for).

title: iOS 15 broke my reminders app
body: Since I've updated my iPhone 12 mini to iOS 15 the reminders app is unstable. It takes a long time to load, sometimes it won't load at all. Once it deleted all of my lists and so on and so on. I will probably start using a third party app for that purpose. A sure let down, it was a useful and reliable app for years and now it's a big let down.
author: Nononga

title: Email dragging feature request
body:
Just discovered the feature of dragging an email on my Mac to the reminders and have a relatively representative reminder appear there.
This is awesome, though it would be even better if this feature could include an auto reply to the mail when the task is added and/or completed.
